name: firefighter-patrol-optimization
description: Emergency response patrol route optimization system for firefighter building inspection

scripts.example: npm run cli -- plan -b examples/basic-6-room.json -a 2 -o results.json
scripts.example:redundancy: npm run cli -- plan -b examples/redundancy-scenario.json -a 3 -r R1,R3 -o redundancy-results.json
scripts.example:return: npm run cli -- plan -b examples/return-to-exit-scenario.json -a 2 --return-to-exit -o return-results.json
scripts.example:combined: npm run cli -- plan -b examples/basic-6-room.json -a 2 -r R1,R3 --return-to-exit -o combined-results.json
scripts.viz:basic: npm run cli -- visualize results.json -o timeline
scripts.viz:redundancy: npm run cli -- visualize redundancy-results.json -o redundancy-timeline
scripts.viz:return: npm run cli -- visualize return-results.json -o return-timeline
scripts.viz:combined: npm run cli -- visualize combined-results.json -o combined-timeline
scripts.example:multi: npm run cli -- plan -b examples/multi-agent-scenario.json -a 5 -r R1,R6,R7 --return-to-exit -o multi-results.json
